notes: Testnet only. No mainnet deploys or transactions.
Public keys only. No private keys or seed phrases are recorded.
Step 6 (delete full-access keys of the registry and mock USDC) is parked until the owner says go. Those full-access keys are still present, so in-place upgrades remain possible.

contracts/res/*.wasm is gitignored, so the exact git commit that produced the deployed wasm is UNVERIFIED. The local sha256 of the built wasm files used for this record matches the on-chain SHA-256 checksums.

The first pay_from_allowance in step 12 (7DJThzgCgnZYf9uNhPgH5ZsuJKx8mJqHkiLcqszdRSTu) was signed with the agent's full-access key before that key was deleted. The report, the refused duplicate pay, and the client-side refused claim used the function-call key.
The agent's claim on s4 with a deposit was refused by the protocol rule (deposit not allowed with a function-call access key) and produced no transaction.
An extra 0.5 NEAR transfer from royltee-dev.testnet to outsider.royltee-dev.testnet ran during step 11, before the refused outsider claim. It is recorded under step 11.
